children: Repulsorlift Inhibitors are simple devices that are buried 1 or 2 meters below the ground. They generate energy wells that disable repulsorlift engines within a 2-square radius. When an active repulsorlift
passes over an area affected by a Repulsorlift Inhibitor, the Repulsorlift Inhibitor makes a +10 attack, which is compared to the Vehicle's
. If the attack succeeds, the target takes 3d10x2
is reduced by half. Repulsorlift Inhibitors continue to function as long as they have a power source. A typical integrated power source can maintain an inhibitor for up to 2 months.
